**Finding: MINCOMMIT — compliant (preferred).**

No minimum purchase, volume commitment, take-or-pay or shortfall mechanic appears anywhere in the Agreement or Exhibit B/Payment Terms. Corio pays only for licences granted and services ordered (licence fees on acceptance, maintenance only while it elects to keep paying, MarketSite access fee, T&M implementation fees capped by the SOW, and revenue share on actual revenue). Volume terms run in our favour (unlimited Software Users, unlimited sublicensed Customers), and Exhibit D's cooperation targets are expressly non-binding. The Exhibit B "40 Authorized Software Users per Customer" floor is a revenue-share calculation condition, not a purchase obligation, so it is noted rather than flagged. No redline proposed.
